partyName: Plaid Cymru - The Party of Wales
note: Death of Ken Taylor; elected Plaid Cymru in Bro'r Llynnoedd at the 2022 Isle of Anglesey County Council election (confirmed via Wikipedia: 2022 Isle of Anglesey County Council election)

Death of David Wilkinson; elected as an Independent in Long Sutton at the 2023 South Holland District Council election, consistent with LEAP's 'RUK gain from Ind' notation (confirmed via Wikipedia: 2023 South Holland District Council election)

Resignation of Alex Armstrong; elected Residents for Uttlesford in Great Dunmow North at the 2023 Uttlesford District Council election, which also directly documents this 2026 by-election as his resignation (Wikipedia: 2023 Uttlesford District Council election)

Resignation of Reform UK councillor Tony Nelson, less than two months after winning the seat for Reform UK at the May 2026 Huntingdonshire District Council election; by-election set for 20 August 2026 (source cites council's official Notice of Vacancy)
